name: txt2sfx
description: Text-to-SFX as code. Sounds that weigh bytes, not megabytes.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared packages/core packages/analyzer packages/optimizer packages/agent packages/bridge apps/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/core packages/analyzer packages/optimizer packages/agent packages/bridge apps/server && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @txt2sfx/web typecheck
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/shared packages/core packages/analyzer packages/optimizer packages/agent packages/bridge apps/server bench
